envelope.description: Prove the gates ignore declared identities and record the s9 inputs

body.title: Prove the gates ignore declared identities and record the s9 inputs
body.summary: Add the gate-identity test (declaring the claimant's login as an alias of another person does not change a team gate's outcome, and nothing under src/workflow/team imports the identity module), classify the identity file writer in the write inventory, and record in docs/plans/core-data-model.md what s9 must do with body.feedback entries and that the body.feedback readers show a mixed view until then.
acceptanceChecks: the team gate's outcome is the same with and without a declared alias for the claimant
no module under src/workflow/team imports the identity module or reads the identity file
the write inventory test passes with the identity writer classified
the plans document lists the s9 inputs from this Story

tests.name: gate-identity.test.ts: the team gate decides on the tracker's whoAmI only: declaring the claimant's login as an alias of another person does not change the gate's outcome, and nothing under src/workflow/team imports the identity module
artifact-write-inventory.test.ts: the identity file writer is classified and appendSidecarLine remains the one raw append for history
